description:
Create an override for a sender identified by an SMTP address. Future messages from that SMTP address will be consistently classified
as specified in the override. Note

💡 TIP: Creates a Focused Inbox override for a sender. Body: { classifyAs: 'focused', senderEmailAddress: { name: 'Display Name', address: 'sender@example.com' } }. classifyAs must be 'focused' or 'other'. If an override already exists for that SMTP address, POST updates the existing override's name and classifyAs (use this to rename a sender). Resolve the sender's address with list-users or by reading a recent mail header — do not invent SMTP addresses.

id.description: The unique identifier for an entity. Read-only.

address.description: The email address of the person or entity.

name.description: The display name of the person or entity.

confirm.description: For destructive operations when the confirm gate is enabled (MS365_MCP_REQUIRE_CONFIRM=true; off by default). Set to true only after the user has explicitly approved this action. When the gate is on, calls without confirm: true return { error: "confirmation_required" } without touching user data.

includeHeaders.description: Include response headers (including ETag) in the response metadata
